I will not put chemical fertilizer on this rented plot because one bag costs too much and 0.2 hectares is too small to use it well. I will plant local cassava cuttings from my own farm and manage the weeding with my family. We do not need to irrigate here because the rains are steady, and I will not waste money on spray for cassava. I expect my children and I to spend about 20 days on this plot from clearing to harvest, and I will not hire anyone because the plot is small.
